task.title: Imitation evaluation metrics: action-match + return-gap + KL
task.summary_zh: 新增 imitation evaluation metrics module：action-match accuracy, return-gap vs expert baseline, KL divergence。獨立於 bc_trainer.py。
acceptance: eval_metrics.py exposes evaluate(behavior_policy_ref eval_trajectories) returning dict with action_match_rate return_gap kl_divergence
test_eval_metrics.py covers 1 perfect-match scenario (rate=1.0) and 1 random-policy scenario (rate ~ 1/n_actions)
output dict is JSON-serializable and stored as evaluation_result artifact type
